summary: October 4, 2026 daji 3.4.5 scoped evidence review, not release promotion. Explicit modal scopes preserve verified baseline admission, historical five-of-six grid research, separate bounded six-fixture banded-inverse candidate research, original-numbering public restoration and local candidate timing without qualifying heterogeneous production recovery, general physical publication, multimode, complete production budgets or current Agent/Headless journeys. Historical installed and scale claims remain intact but cannot close unrelated named scopes. Empty bindings identify open obligations, not absence of all solver functionality.

qualification_requirements.acceptance: Preserve retained public bounded single-mode successes, independent physical JSON checks and explicit rejected inputs. This verified baseline is not general multimode, heterogeneous recovery, live Agent or installed qualification.

Qualify public production recovery on all six retained valid graded/layered inputs at scales 1, 1e14 and 1e-10. Retain actual assembled seeds, frozen roots during proposals, unchanged 1e-8 residual and strict physical unit-norm gates, independent reassembly, bounded work and fail-closed negative cases. Test-only five-fixture recovery and old installed truss/thermal journeys do not close this scope.

Extend the verified bounded public fault/cancellation baseline to qualified production candidate admission and physical publication, with immutable retained input, no partial results, bounded allocations/checks and healthy replay. Final test-only beam cancellation is useful research evidence but cannot replace production-path fault qualification.

Preserve historical direct-grid five-of-six, banded-inverse six-fixture, ranked and original-chart handoff evidence including two changed-material failures under separate cold handoff/ranked/full routes. Frozen roots, original seeds, unchanged residual/unit-norm gates and original-numbered independent physical certification remain mandatory. A separate cold inward physical chart selects its one-step anchor before its sole physical fit, carries only the internal strategy tag and never retries after faults or cancellation. Retain 24 parameter inputs, 52 fresh rebuilt readbacks, 28 exact numbering controls, eighteen spectral/inertia/direction relations, real signed/final-fault/restoration-cancellation/replay controls and explicit one-fit/seven-check caps. The 36-input physical-chart holdout preserves four internal/one physical failures, 31 common accepted pairs and sixteen improved/fifteen regressed margins. The later cold internal chart preserves 204 isolated diagnostics with six preparation faults and 108 fresh rebuilt routes: one gained three-layer input and one regressed unequal-length input, with 31 accepted results under each policy. Retain two-fit/thirteen-check internal bounds, exact failed-fit accounting, per-input boundaries and real final-internal/publication cancellation/replay. Reference-only old directions never seed searches. Original chart failures, baseline residual regressions and tied-anchor declines remain explicit. Private horizontal single-mode research does not claim universal improvement, arbitrary topology, production ordering/admission, full budgets, benchmark or Agent/Headless qualification. Retain the later 84-route precision comparison and 144 isolated material/order routes: distinguish overwritten current-column tails from retained tiny-fill faults without weakening bounds. The separate cold Givens beam gains three and loses five normalized fixed-order acceptances, has five guarded factor failures and produces zero physical publications. Preserve exact per-input stages, analytic controls, real sign/renumbering/fault/cancellation replays; these internal-only results cannot certify a composed pipeline or production recovery. Retain the banded finite-box comparison over 42 inputs and 84 separate cold one/four-pass routes, with nine common normalized holdout acceptances and zero old-baseline recoveries. Three difficult 128-member cases stay unresolved. The 729-state frontier, per-pass/cumulative budgets, independent receipts, exhaustive controls and real final-fault/cancellation/fresh-numbering replay are test-only. A computed finite-box minimum is not an interval proof, physical publication or a production strategy promotion. Retain 128 amplitude charts with no added QR-to-DP recovery, 96 rounded-beam diagnostics and 168 fixed-order material/order routes with ten normalized gains and one old-success regression. Keep width/radius/certificate budgets separate, certify each proposal with actual operator products, and retain the failed physical restoration of the internally recovered 100-member tiny input under two numbering layouts. Four primary healthy original-numbered readbacks and final fault/cancellation replay do not close production scopes or justify default replacement. Retain the later 42-input/126-route physical-first joint comparison with 37 old full-pipeline acceptances versus one GridNorm and two Reverse acceptances. This joint policy adds post-physical rounded internal re-encoding at the frozen initializer anchor, a stronger experimental condition absent from the old publication contract. Its failures do not invalidate old admitted shapes or prove global nonrepresentability. Keep all hard-input and old-baseline joint rejections, exact per-input stages, paired receipt/work caps, analytic controls, real sign/material/fresh-numbering/fault and late cancellation/publication replay. This negative construction cannot replace defaults or qualify production recovery. Retain the later contract-preserving coupled two-stage comparison over 42 inputs and 126 cold routes: old/GridNorm/Reverse accept 37/36/28. The gained unequal-length 128-member tiny physical output passes independent JSON readback, but GridNorm loses two old successes and Reverse loses nine. Mapped physical residual ranks only internally eligible directions; no post-physical re-encoding gate is imposed. Preserve separate one-fit/eighteen-receipt stages, at most fifty-four proposal operator products, hard failures, strict final physical norm and real last-pair/unit-validation/restoration/publication cancellation with fresh exact replay. This gain does not close production scopes or justify default replacement. Retain twelve stage ablations and the later 42-input/126-route legacy-first physical hybrid comparison. All 37 old successful JSON outputs and factor/receipt counts match exactly; the old internal policy plus same-factor residual-only physical beam continuation gains one tiny unequal-length input and accepts 38, with no old-success loss. Keep four hard internal rejections, one physical fit/twenty-five receipts at width sixteen, no continuation after faults/cancellation/stale greedy gates/unit-norm loss, actual final operator faults, signed/renumbered readbacks and fresh exact replay. This bounded positive research result is not general geometry, public Solver, Engine/Agent or production qualification. Retain the later 72-route breadth/iteration diagnostic and 42-input/84-route old-first supplementary internal comparison. All 38 prior successful JSON outputs and fit/receipt counts match exactly; a cold preselected Reverse width-64 internal pass after numerical exhaustion gains the 100-member ThreeLayers tiny physical readback, for 39 of 42 accepted. Three 128-member internal failures remain. Narrower repeated passes gain no physical output despite internal improvement. Preserve fixed cumulative radius, three-fit/seventy-nine-receipt extended internal bounds, unchanged physical gates, stale-eligibility/fault/cancel stops, signed/fresh-numbering results and late-cancel/exact-replay controls. This private Solver construction neither certifies whole-pipeline budgets nor closes production or Engine/Agent scopes. Bounded lattice research adds 24 adjacent-pair routes with zero acceptances and twelve bounded triangular routes with two alternate independent physical readbacks on the already recovered 100-member tiny input. Distinct retained coverage stays 39 of 42; three 128-member internal failures remain. Exact integer transformations freeze the original anchor, grid and radius. Eight step limits and four integer limits retain only the last whole safe basis; arithmetic faults and cancellation stop rather than become budget outcomes. Keep two-factor/sixty-six-receipt construction limits, explicitly larger separate work reservations, strict physical gates, analytic/exhaustive controls, real signed/fresh-numbering/final-product faults and late-cancel/exact-replay evidence. No new input, whole-pipeline budget, production scope, default or Engine/Agent strategy is qualified.

Verify the separate precision controls, four-state/six-certificate cap, eight accepted order proposals across five fixtures, independent physical readbacks, sign/numbering controls and real final-cancellation replay. A wider successful ordering count is not a sixth recovered fixture or a production fix.

Qualify final production physical shapes over the retained heterogeneous and unequal-length failures with strict unit norm, original positive masses and independent stiffness/mass reconstruction after JSON readback. An internal normalized candidate or successful alternative test-only physical stage cannot certify the ordinary production publication path.

Qualify the retained long-bending six-mode production request and clustered/nonseparable modes with independent spectral indices, mass orthogonality or invariant subspaces, final physical residuals, duplicate rejection and late-mode cancellation. Single-mode candidate success does not close multimode recovery.

Rebuild valid public requests after node/member renumbering and independently assemble operators, seeds and final references. Preserve spectral and physical invariance without simultaneous permutation of a fixed assembled pair. The bounded public baseline remains verified, not qualified. Later original-chart and inward-chart candidate reconstruction is a private horizontal-chain test harness, not production NodeOrder or general heterogeneous admission. The original-chart material failures remain asserted; inward-chart 52-readback successes and margin regression, or the later 36-input holdout with five common failures, do not close this qualified public scope.

Preserve the separate direct-grid and borrowed banded-inverse six-process optimized campaigns, each with one warmup and three fresh samples, exact outcome replay, complete measured phases and observed process-high-water RSS with its stated limits. Additional full-versus-ranked and ranked-versus-handoff pairs must rebuild each member and alternate sample order. Retain historical tiny-layer regressions/long tails and all slower handoff cases rather than claim a universal speedup. Handoff carries only a strategy tag into one independently checked physical fit, with no fallback or certificate reuse. Record actual recovery certificate callbacks rather than duplicate nested checkpoints, factor/substitution/polish counts and scoped cumulative grid reservations. These numbers do not measure the separate wide-beam algorithm, public solver throughput, remote execution or incremental heap, and do not qualify a production work or memory budget.

Qualify complete production preparation, eigensolve, ordinary polishing, both correction stages and physical JSON publication with cumulative work/check accounting, allocation ownership, peak memory, measured repeats and cancellation. Separate per-stage plans or candidate timing cannot close this budget; unrelated retained 1M truss/thermal scale claims cannot substitute.

After production admission, retain actual Agent TaskIR/RPC recovery of the heterogeneous modal cases, independent physical output checks, authority/digest validation, error propagation and a healthy next task after failure/cancellation. Earlier modal baselines and in-process candidate tests cannot qualify this new journey.

Retain an official Rust Headless study-to-production solve/export/readback/recovery journey for the heterogeneous cases after production admission. Do not add an ad-hoc research CLI or count test-only candidate helpers as SDK functionality. Python and Elixir installed journeys remain separately tracked in the existing scope inventory.
